thread:
nora: FYI we're planning two partner-facing breaking changes next quarter: (1) batch payload switches from array 'items' -> object 'requests_map' (helps retry determinism), (2) replace X-Partner-Signature header with standard Bearer auth. Need partner plan.

sam: Sketch a tiny migration snippet for the market images so we can show partners.

nora: Old -> new sample inline: OLD: { "items": [{"id":"a","input":"..."}] , "X-Partner-Signature": "sha256=..." }  NEW: { "requests_map": {"a":{"input":"..."}}, "authorization": "Bearer <token>" }

kevin: Installer hooks and 3 SI adapters use the legacy header today. That's the biggest risk.

isabelle: Suggest runtime compat flag: set header 'X-Compat-Mode: legacy' to accept old header for 8 weeks. We'll log usage and rate-limit to detect stragglers.

partner-bot: Runbook created -> https://console.redwood.com/partners/batch-auth-migration (tags: #marketplace #compat).

sam: Ops can add a feature-flagged server-side compat acceptance per tenant and emit telemetry. We'll ship SDK polyfills (npm/pip) with migrate helpers.

kevin: Rollout proposal: announce week0, SDK polyfills & quickstart week1, partner canaries + marketplace builds weeks2-6, deprecate legacy header for new requests week8, remove acceptance week14. Stagger marketplace -> SI -> on-prem.

isabelle: Add canary gating: error rate <0.3% and median parsing time within +15% for 72h before removal. Also prioritize red partners for outreach and offer proxying if they cannot update.

nora: Action items: @sam feature flag + logging by Tue EOD; @isabelle partner outreach + FAQ by Wed; @kevin compile stoplight matrix + list of impacted images by Wed. Support to open priority tickets for red partners.

sam: Will include tiny shim: `migrateBatch(items)` that returns requests_map, and publish `npm install @redwood/partner-shim` / `pip install redwood-partner-shim`.

isabelle: FAQ will include rebuild checklist for marketplace images, sample adapter diff, and rollback steps. Also flag PR/marketing opt-in for partners that finish early.

partner-bot: Reminder set for Fri 09:30 to review gating metrics.

nora: If anyone finds hard-pinned adapters that can't be changed, ping immediately so we can propose a runtime proxy. Otherwise follow the schedule above. :thumbsup:
